name: Owlin Spiralmancer
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, you may copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, you may copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key `x_in_mana_cost` (printed {X} in the spell's mana cost) that is also counted by the `nth` ordinal, so `nth: 1` with `filter: {x_in_mana_cost: true}` means "your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn" rather than "your first spell, if it has {X}"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: x_in_mana_cost exists only as a selector key (selectors.py) and a mana-restriction predicate; it is not in the packet's trigger_filter_keys, and `nth` on spell_cast counts earlier spells only through ORDINAL_FILTER_KEYS (triggers._spell_ordinal / _matches_printed), which omits it. The trigger filter's `mana_cost` key matches an exact printed cost string, not the presence of {X}. Without a filtered ordinal, an unfiltered nth:1 would miss an X spell cast after a non-X spell, and max_per_turn cannot help because the trigger filter cannot name {X} in the first place
